overall_assessment: Extraction with #right-main works well at UiA: all 27 random controls are complete, well-structured plans (learning outcomes, content, teaching, requirements, exam), and the only uncaptured page text is the breadcrumb. The one 'short' suspect is a stub page with only the facts box; remaining issues are small recurring noise and source-side duplicates.

findings.evidence:
Innholdsfortegnelse
Emnet er tilknyttet følgende studieprogram

findings.description: The short flag is real but not an extraction defect: the page itself carries only the facts box (credits, department, responsible, semester, duration) and no learning outcomes, content or assessment. The page text not captured is just the breadcrumb, so nothing was lost. The record is a plan-less stub that looks like a normal extracted text downstream (1 of 28 sampled; random controls all have plans).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The FS page for this offering has no plan text published; extraction is faithful.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat offerings whose extracted text lacks any plan heading (Læringsutbytte, Innhold, Eksamen) as 'no plan' (e.g. report in the gaps target) so they are excluded from section analyses.

findings.description: Every text carries the table-of-contents label 'Innholdsfortegnelse', the label 'Emnet er tilknyttet følgende studieprogram' (often followed by an empty list) and a final footer line 'Sist hentet fra FS (Felles studentsystem) <timestamp>'. These are page chrome, not plan content; the footer varies per fetch time.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: #right-main includes the contents box and the FS fetch footer; no exclude/post_fn removes them in R/institution_config.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exclude/post_fn for the 'Innholdsfortegnelse' heading and a regex dropping '^Sist hent(et|a) fra FS .*$' (also nynorsk 'Sist henta frå FS'); keep the programme list if wanted as metadata.

findings.description: The language of instruction appears twice in the text: once in the facts box ('Undervisningsspråk:' + value) and again as a separate 'Undervisningsspråk' section later (the second is followed by 'Læringsutbytte'). Seen in all 2025 courses and many 2022 ones.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page renders the facts box and a full-width 'Undervisningsspråk' section; both are inside #right-main.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the later 'Undervisningsspråk' heading and its value line via post_fn (the facts-box copy is kept).

findings.description: The 'Reduksjon i studiepoeng' table lists the same row several times (SE-204 lists SE-2400 four times and itself; SYP212 lists SYP205 and SYP215 twice and itself). Boilerplate-like credit-reduction lists, repeated.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Duplicate rows come from the FS source table; extraction passes them through unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Deduplicate adjacent/identical table lines in post_fn; optionally drop the whole 'Reduksjon i studiepoeng' block as non-plan text.

findings.description: Offerings titled 'Høst 2022' show 'Undervisningssemester: Vår' in the facts box (also SE-204 'Høst 2020' and TFL939). The plan year is right (year page), but the page's semester field disagrees with the offering, so it must not be used as the offering's semester.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page is the year page for the course code and carries the course's regular teaching semester, which can differ from the offering row's semester.
findings.suggested_fix: Never derive semester from the 'Undervisningssemester' line; rely on the offering's own semester field.
